column1: # coverage-map.tsv — which test backs which requirement
# This file is the machine-readable half of 01_requirements/TRACEABILITY_MATRIX.md.
# The matrix is the narrative; this is the claim ledger the HTML report verifies.
#   requirement  An ID that exists in 01_requirements/DrivingCoach_SRS_v1.md.
#                Unknown IDs are reported as errors, not ignored.
#   test         A test class simple name (e.g. GeoUtilsTest) or a specific
#                Prefix with "L4:" for a manual acceptance test ID (e.g. L4:BRD-01).
#                The test level is NOT recorded here: the report derives it from
#                where the class actually ran, so this file cannot claim the
#   note         Free text. Shown in the report, never parsed.
# ONE CLAIM PER LINE. A requirement backed by three tests gets three lines.
# The report marks each claim from real results:
#   PASS     the cited test ran and passed
#   SKIPPED  the cited test exists but did not run (e.g. @Ignore) — claim unbacked
#   MISSING  the cited test was not found at all — the citation has rotted
#   MANUAL   an L4 claim, which only a human can discharge
# Editing rule: add the claim in the same commit as the test that backs it.
